remarks: Charming Ranch-Style Duplex in the Heart of Norwalk! Welcome home to this spacious 2-bedroom ranch-style half duplex (located on the 2nd Floor) ideally located in the heart of Norwalk. This inviting home features beautiful hardwood flooring throughout the bedrooms and living room, along with large closets offering plenty of storage. The renovated kitchen opens to a bright, sun-filled three-season porch-perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing at the end of the day. The renovated bathroom features a convenient walk-in shower. Additional highlights include a large full basement with washer and dryer hookups and ample storage space. Conveniently located near major highways, parks, restaurants, shopping plazas, downtown SoNo, and Norwalk's beautiful beaches, this home offers both comfort and convenience. Rental Requirements: Applicants must have a minimum credit score of 675 and applications must be submitted through RentSpree.
